_note: Hand-authored layer: slug, In-brief copy, keywords, and which PDF (if any) citation_pdf_url should point at. Merged with papers.auto.json (extracted from index.html) by build_papers.py. Papers listed in _skip already have hand-built pages.

pados2026learning.takeaway: Can a network read a matrix and pick the solver?
pados2026learning.context: Solver speed on sparse systems swings wildly with sparsity structure. A CNN is trained on spy-plot images of that structure to predict which candidate solver will be faster.

metcalfe2026arrays.takeaway: Scale geothermal by networking many standard wells, not by building bigger ones.
metcalfe2026arrays.context: The case for geothermal arrays: smaller, competitively sourced, standard wells linked together, rather than ever-larger single installations — aiming at high capacity factors and sub-cent electricity.

wittenstein2026full.takeaway: Can a whole array of deep boreholes be simulated in three dimensions?
wittenstein2026full.context: An operator splitting tailored to the physics — vertical diffusion, horizontal diffusion and advection handled separately — makes multi-well arrays tractable on a single GPU, released as GeothermalWells.jl.

shah2025data.takeaway: Can a language model write the dispatch heuristic?
shah2025data.context: Given a curated performance database and careful prompting, LLaMA 3 synthesizes algorithm-selection heuristics that replicate expert-designed strategies for LU factorization.

ouko2025decision.takeaway: How far can language models be trusted as geothermal expert assistants?
ouko2025decision.context: Assesses frontier and domain-specific models as decision support for well arrays and closed-loop coaxial wells, using them to generate quantitative benchmarks while weighing bias and hallucination.

matos2021performance.takeaway: Can relaying keep IoT devices connected at the edge of coverage?
matos2021performance.context: Device-to-device relaying added to NB-IoT, evaluated across urban and suburban environments where out-of-coverage devices would otherwise lose connectivity unnecessarily.

lujan2019extreme.takeaway: Which link parameters still work underground?
lujan2019extreme.context: In extreme coverage only a few modulation-and-repetition combinations are viable at all. A lookup table returns the optimal choice quickly, and that scarcity turns out to make the scheme robust against measurement uncertainty.

mellino2019lite.takeaway: A protocol simulator for the NB-IoT uplink.
mellino2019lite.context: Implements the NB-IoT physical layer and uplink scheduling, then uses it to trace block-error-rate curves and derive optimal link adaptation for an AWGN channel.

lujan2019libregrowth.takeaway: Tumour growth and infiltration, simulated in parallel.
lujan2019libregrowth.context: A libre C++/OpenMP code solving a reaction-diffusion model with spatially variable diffusion in three dimensions, covering both benign and malignant stages.

lujan2019towards.takeaway: What is the right pulse dosage for gene delivery?
lujan2019towards.context: Frames gene electrotransfer as a dose-response problem: maximum reversibly electroporated tissue against damage from pH fronts — damage that is negligible in shorter-pulse protocols but not in GET.

lujan2019integrated.takeaway: One platform for monitoring, controlling and planning urban energy.
lujan2019integrated.context: The CC-SEM project: a low-cost IoT device for home appliances, NB-IoT assessed as the carrier, and cloud analytics for both consumption and generation.

lujan2018cloud.takeaway: Cloud, IoT and HPC brought together for city energy.
lujan2018cloud.context: The CC-SEM platform serves citizens controlling home devices and operators simulating generation scenarios, with purpose-built monitoring hardware and its communication infrastructure.

lujan2018microenvironmental.takeaway: Why does the same tumour infiltrate differently?
lujan2018microenvironmental.context: Pairing in vitro spheroids with a 3D diffusion-convection-reaction model shows adipocyte-conditioned media switching the infiltration pattern from collective and laminar to individual and atomized.

lujan2017modelado.takeaway: How do you describe a tumour invasion pattern?
lujan2017modelado.context: A reaction-diffusion-convection model whose spatially variable diffusion follows a DLA fractal matrix, with parameters estimated from experiment and validated by box-counting and lacunarity. Published in Spanish.

lujan2016mathematical.takeaway: Can one model both describe and predict spheroid invasion?
lujan2016mathematical.context: The same model runs case-specific or population-dependent, depending on whether its shape function comes from one experiment or from data mining and Monte Carlo across the whole dataset.
lujan2016mathematical._note: RSC 'getauthorversionpdf' redirects to the abstract and reports 'You do not currently have access to this content', so it is dropped.

lujan2016electrolytic.takeaway: How much charge ablates the tumour and no more?
lujan2016electrolytic.context: A dose-planning methodology for electrolytic ablation with a one-probe two-electrode device, in terms of the coulomb dosage administered and the pH fronts that do the destroying.

lujan2015optimal.takeaway: What is the optimal charge for electrolytic ablation?
lujan2015optimal.context: Nernst-Planck modelling of ion transport identifies coulomb dosage as the reliable dose parameter, and predicts necrotized tumour volume scaling nonlinearly, as Q to the 1.4.

zubov2021neuralpde.takeaway: Physics-informed neural networks, generated from a symbolic PDE.
zubov2021neuralpde.context: NeuralPDE.jl builds its training code from an abstract symbolic formulation, with quadrature-based losses that adapt toward bounded error tolerances — demonstrated on the Doyle-Fuller-Newman battery model.
